// If already a number, treat as minutes since midnight if (typeof str === 'number') return str; str = String(str).trim().toLowerCase(); // Try 24h format: "14:00", "9:30" let match = str.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/); if (match) { return parseInt(match[1]) * 60 + parseInt(match[2]); } // Try 12h format: "2:00pm", "9am", "12:30 am" match = str.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(am|pm)$/); if (match) { let hours = parseInt(match[1]); const minutes = parseInt(match[2] || '0'); const period = match[3]; if (period === 'pm' && hours !== 12) hours += 12; if (period === 'am' && hours === 12) hours = 0; return hours * 60 + minutes; } return null; } // Format minutes since midnight into a readable string like "2:00 PM" formatTime(minutes) { if (minutes == null) return ''; const h = Math.floor(minutes / 60); const m = minutes % 60; const period = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM'; const h12 = h === 0 ? 12 : h > 12 ? h - 12 : h; return `${h12}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')} ${period}`; } // ========== TOOL IMPLEMENTATIONS ========== // 1. Get Schedule Summary async getScheduleSummary(params) { const { time_range = 'all' } = params; const items = window.OrganizerStore?.items || []; const events = items.filter(item => item.type === 'event'); // Calculate date range const now = new Date(); const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()); let startDate, endDate; switch (time_range.toLowerCase()) { case 'today': startDate = today; endDate = new Date(today); endDate.setDate(endDate.getDate() + 1); break; case 'tomorrow': startDate = new Date(today); startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() + 1); endDate = new Date(startDate); endDate.setDate(endDate.getDate() + 1); break; case 'this week': startDate = today; endDate = new Date(today); endDate.setDate(endDate.getDate() + 7); break; case 'next week': startDate = new Date(today); startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() + 7); endDate = new Date(startDate); endDate.setDate(endDate.getDate() + 7); break; default: startDate = new Date(0); endDate = new Date('2100-01-01'); } // Filter events in range const filteredEvents = events.filter(event => { const eventDate = new Date(event.scheduledDate || event.due || event.dateValue); return eventDate >= startDate && eventDate < endDate; }); // Format summary if (filteredEvents.length === 0) { return { summary: `No events scheduled for ${time_range}.`, events: [] }; } // Sort by date filteredEvents.sort((a, b) => { const dateA = new Date(a.scheduledDate || a.due || a.dateValue); const dateB = new Date(b.scheduledDate || b.due || b.dateValue); return dateA - dateB; }); const summary = filteredEvents.map(event => { const date = new Date(event.scheduledDate || event.due || event.dateValue); const dateStr = date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }); return `- ${dateStr}: ${event.name || event.title || 'Untitled Event'}`; }).join('\n'); return { summary: `Events for ${time_range}:\n${summary}`, events: filteredEvents, count: filteredEvents.length }; } // 2. Search Notes async searchNotes(params) { const { query, topic_filter } = params; const state = window.appState || window.state; if (!state || !state.panels) { return { results: [], summary: 'No notes found.' }; } const notePanels = state.panels.filter(p => p.type === 'note' && p.active !== false); let matchingNotes = []; for (const panel of notePanels) { const content = (panel.content || '').toLowerCase(); const title = (panel.title || '').toLowerCase(); const searchQuery = query.toLowerCase(); const topicMatch = !topic_filter || title.includes(topic_filter.toLowerCase()); if (topicMatch && (content.includes(searchQuery) || title.includes(searchQuery))) { // Find snippet const contentLower = panel.content || ''; const index = contentLower.toLowerCase().indexOf(searchQuery); const snippetStart = Math.max(0, index - 50); const snippetEnd = Math.min(contentLower.length, index + searchQuery.length + 50); const snippet = contentLower.substring(snippetStart, snippetEnd); matchingNotes.push({ title: panel.title, snippet: '...' + snippet + '...', id: panel.id }); } } if (matchingNotes.length === 0) { return { results: [], summary: `No notes found matching "${query}".` }; } const summary = matchingNotes.map(note => `"${note.title}": ${note.snippet}` ).join('\n\n'); return { results: matchingNotes, summary: `Found ${matchingNotes.length} note(s) matching "${query}":\n\n${summary}`, count: matchingNotes.length }; } // 2b. Find Schedule Conflicts async findScheduleConflicts(params) { const { time_range = 'all' } = params; const items = window.OrganizerStore?.items || []; const events = items.filter(item => item.type === 'event' && (item.scheduledDate || item.dateValue)); const conflicts = []; // Check each event against others for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) { for (let j = i + 1; j < events.length; j++) { const event1 = events[i]; const event2 = events[j]; const date1 = event1.scheduledDate || event1.dateValue; const date2 = event2.scheduledDate || event2.dateValue; // Events must be on the same date to conflict if (date1 !== date2) continue; // If both have time info, check for time overlap if (event1.start != null && event2.start != null) { const end1 = event1.end || (event1.start + (event1.duration || 60)); const end2 = event2.end || (event2.start + (event2.duration || 60)); // Overlap check: start1 < end2 AND start2 < end1 if (event1.start < end2 && event2.start < end1) { conflicts.push({ event1: event1.name || 'Untitled', event2: event2.name || 'Untitled', date: date1, timeOverlap: true }); } } else { // No time info on one or both - flag as potential conflict on same day conflicts.push({ event1: event1.name || 'Untitled', event2: event2.name || 'Untitled', date: date1, timeOverlap: false }); } } } if (conflicts.length === 0) { return { conflicts: [], summary: 'No scheduling conflicts found.' }; } const summary = conflicts.map(c => `${c.date}: "${c.event1}" conflicts with "${c.event2}"${c.timeOverlap ? Tile Panels async tilePanels(params) { const state = window.appState || window.state; if (!state || !state.panels || !window.panelManager) { throw new Error('Panel system not available'); } const activePanels = state.panels.filter(p => p.active !== false); if (activePanels.length === 0) { return { success: true, message: 'No panels to tile' }; } // Calculate grid layout const cols = Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(activePanels.length)); const rows = Math.ceil(activePanels.length / cols); const padding = 16; const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth - padding * 2; const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight - padding * 2; const panelWidth = Math.floor((viewportWidth - (cols - 1) * padding) / cols); const panelHeight = Math.floor((viewportHeight - (rows - 1) * padding) / rows); // Position each panel activePanels.forEach((panel, index) => { const col = index % cols; const row = Math.floor(index / cols); panel.x = padding + col * (panelWidth + padding); panel.y = padding + row * (panelHeight + padding); panel.w = panelWidth; panel.h = panelHeight; }); // Refresh UI window.panelManager.refreshFromState(); return { success: true, message: `Tiled ${activePanels.length} panels in a ${cols}x${rows} grid` }; } // 7. Create Prioritized Task List async createPrioritizedTaskList(params) { const { criteria } = params; const items = window.OrganizerStore?.items || []; // Filter tasks based on criteria (use completedAt/status from current schema) let tasks = items.filter(item => (item.type === 'task' || item.type === 'note') && !item.completedAt && item.status !== 'done' ); // Parse criteria (simple implementation) const criteriaLower = criteria.toLowerCase(); if (criteriaLower.includes('this week')) { const now = new Date(); const weekEnd = new Date(now); weekEnd.setDate(weekEnd.getDate() + 7); tasks = tasks.filter(task => { const dueDate = new Date(task.due || task.scheduledDate || task.dateValue); return dueDate <= weekEnd; }); } // Sort by due date tasks.sort((a, b) => { const dateA = new Date(a.due || a.scheduledDate || a.dateValue || '2100-01-01'); const dateB = new Date(b.due || b.scheduledDate || b.dateValue || '2100-01-01'); return dateA - dateB; }); // Format as markdown const markdown = `# Prioritized Tasks\n\n${ tasks.length === 0 ? Group Panels By Type async groupPanelsByType(params) { const state = window.appState || window.state; if (!state || !state.panels || !window.panelManager) { throw new Error('Panel system not available'); } const activePanels = state.panels.filter(p => p.active !== false); if (activePanels.length === 0) { return { success: true, message: 'No panels to organize' }; } // Group by type const groups = {}; activePanels.forEach(panel => { const type = panel.type || 'other'; if (!groups[type]) groups[type] = []; groups[type].push(panel); }); const padding = 16; const groupSpacing = 50; let currentX = padding; // Arrange each group vertically Object.entries(groups).forEach(([type, panels]) => { let currentY = padding; const maxWidth = Math.max(...panels.map(p => p.w || 400)); panels.forEach((panel, index) => { panel.x = currentX; panel.y = currentY; currentY += (panel.h || 300) + padding; panel.updatedAt = Date.now(); }); currentX += maxWidth + groupSpacing; }); // Refresh UI window.panelManager.refreshFromState(); const typeNames = Object.keys(groups).join(', '); // Emit event this.emitEvent('workspace.organized', { action: 'groupByType', panelCount: activePanels.length, groupCount: Object.keys(groups).length }); return { success: true, message: `Grouped ${activePanels.length} panels by type: ${typeNames}`, groupCount: Object.keys(groups).length }; } // 24. Source: `system-prompt.js` + `context-provider.js` --- ## System Prompt (sent with every message) **Source file:** `system-prompt.js` → `buildBasePrompt()` ``` You are the briizOS AI Assistant, a productivity AI integrated into briizOS (also known as glOS). # Available Tools ## Read-Only Tools - getScheduleSummary(time_range) - View scheduled events - searchNotes(query, topic_filter?) - Search through notes - lookupOnline(query, target?, source?) - Search the web (placeholder - not yet wired up) - findScheduleConflicts(time_range?) - Find overlapping events (uses time ranges if available) ## Panel Management Tools - openPanel(panel_title) - Open an existing panel - createNotePanel(title, content?) - Create a new note panel with optional content - updateNoteContent(panel_id, new_content) - REPLACES all content of a note panel - setPanelColor(panel_id, hue, saturation, lightness) - Change panel color (HSL: 0-360, 0-100, 0-100) - movePanel(panel_id, x, y) - Move panel to specific coordinates - resizePanel(panel_id, width, height) - Resize panel to specific dimensions - duplicatePanel(panel_id) - Duplicate an existing panel - deletePanel(panel_id) - Delete a panel - minimizePanel(panel_id) - Minimize a panel - restorePanel(panel_id) - Restore a minimized panel - setPanelTitle(panel_id, new_title) - Change panel title ## Workspace Organization Tools - tilePanels() - Arrange panels in a grid - groupPanelsByType() - Auto-arrange panels grouped by type - stackPanelsVertically(panel_ids?) - Stack panels vertically (all or specified) - focusMode(panel_id) - Minimize all panels except one - minimizeAllPanels() - Minimize all active panels - closeAllPanels(confirm) - Close all panels (requires confirm: true) ## Task & Event Management Tools - completeTask(task_id) - Mark a task as completed (uses toggleDone → sets completedAt + status) - createThoughtStream(text, priority?, due_date?) - Create a floating thoughtstream task - createPrioritizedTaskList(criteria) - Generate prioritized task list - createSingleCalendarEvent(title, date, time?, duration?) - Create event. time = "9am", "2:30pm", "14:00". duration = minutes. - updateCalendarEvent(event_title, new_date, target_date?) - Move/modify event - createRecurringCalendarEvent(title, recurrence_type, days_of_week, start_date?, time?, duration?) - Create recurring event. Recurrence stored as proper object {enabled, type, daysOfWeek, anchorDate, endDate}. ## Workspace Tools - startTimer(duration_minutes, title?) - Create a timer ``` ### Rules given to AI 1. Tools are OPTIONAL - only use when the user requests a specific action 2. Greetings, questions, clarifications = NO tools - respond naturally 3. Recognize intent, not exact words 4. **Use the minimum tools needed** - multiple tools per response allowed when the request requires it 5. If uncertain about parameters, ask - don't guess ### Tool Call Format The AI is instructed to emit tool calls as JSON inside markdown code fences: ```` ```json {"tool": "toolName", "params": {"param1": "value1"}} ``` ```` ### Guidelines - Be concise and conversational - Use exact panel/event titles when known from context - Dates: YYYY-MM-DD format - Times: human-readable strings like "9am", "2:30pm", "14:00" (parsed to minutes-since-midnight in JS) - **updateNoteContent replaces ALL content** - AI is told to use searchNotes first to read existing content before updating - If no tool exists for something, suggest alternatives --- ## Dynamic Context (appended to system prompt) **Source file:** `context-provider.js` → `formatContextString()` This is injected at the end of the system prompt on every message. It provides the AI with live state: ``` # Current BriizOS State **Time:** Friday, February 14, 2026, 11:30 AM ## Active Panels (3) - note: "Project Notes" Preview: ## Current Sprint\nTask 1: Fix login bug\nTask 2: Update API... - timer: "Timer" (minimized) - external: "Calendar" ## Recent Tasks (2) - Buy groceries (due: 2026-02-15) - Review code ## Upcoming Events (1) - 2026-02-16: Team Meeting ## Organizer Summary - Total items: 12 - Active items: 8 ``` ### Context data sources | Section | Source | What it reads | |---------|--------|---------------| | Time | `new Date()` | Current date/time | | Panels | `window.appState.panels` | Active panels with type, title, minimized state, **note content preview (first 120 chars)** | | Tasks | `window.OrganizerStore.items` | Items where type=task/note, filtered by `completedAt`/`status` | | Events | `window.OrganizerStore.items` | Items where type=event, upcoming only | | Organizer | `window.OrganizerStore.items` | Total/active counts | --- ## Custom Prompts Users can set a custom prompt via **Chat Settings** (`chat-settings.js`). - Stored in `localStorage` key: `briizos.chatSettings.v1` - Path: `providers.{gemini|openai|claude}.prompt` - Custom prompts are **appended** to the base system prompt under a `# User Custom Instructions` heading — tools remain available --- ## Error Feedback When a tool call fails at runtime: 1. The error message is shown to the user in the chat ("Sorry, that action failed: ...") 2. The error context is stored in `_lastToolError` 3. On the user's next message, the error is injected as a system message so the AI can acknowledge it and suggest alternatives --- ## How to inspect prompts at runtime Open the browser console and run: ```js // See the full system prompt being sent window.inspectSystemPrompt() // See all tool definitions window.inspectTools() // See the dynamic context window.contextProvider.formatContextString() ``` All API requests are also logged to the console with the full message payload (look for the robot emoji log group). // System Prompt - Defines AI behavior and available tools for briizOS class SystemPrompt { constructor() { this.basePrompt = this.buildBasePrompt(); } // Build the base system prompt buildBasePrompt() { return `You are the briizOS AI Assistant, a productivity AI integrated into briizOS (also known as glOS). # Available Tools ## Read-Only Tools - **getScheduleSummary**(time_range) - View scheduled events - **searchNotes**(query, topic_filter?) - Search through notes - **lookupOnline**(query, target?, source?) - Search the web and optionally create a panel with results - **findScheduleConflicts**(time_range?) - Find overlapping events ## Panel Management Tools - **openPanel**(panel_title) - Open an existing panel - **createNotePanel**(title, content?) - Create a new note panel with optional content - **updateNoteContent**(panel_id, new_content, mode?) - Update content of a note panel. Appends by default. Use mode: "replace" to overwrite. - **setPanelColor**(panel_id, hue, saturation, lightness) - Change panel color (HSL: 0-360, 0-100, 0-100) - **movePanel**(panel_id, x, y) - Move panel to specific coordinates - **resizePanel**(panel_id, width, height) - Resize panel to specific dimensions - **duplicatePanel**(panel_id) - Duplicate an existing panel - **deletePanel**(panel_id) - Delete a panel - **minimizePanel**(panel_id) - Minimize a panel - **restorePanel**(panel_id) - Restore a minimized panel - **setPanelTitle**(panel_id, new_title) - Change panel title ## Workspace Organization Tools - **tilePanels**() - Arrange panels in a grid - **groupPanelsByType**() - Auto-arrange panels grouped by type - **stackPanelsVertically**(panel_ids?) - Stack panels vertically (all or specified) - **focusMode**(panel_id) - Minimize all panels except one - **minimizeAllPanels**() - Minimize all active panels - **closeAllPanels**(confirm) - Close all panels (requires confirm: true) ## Task & Event Management Tools - **completeTask**(task_id) - Mark a task as completed - **createThoughtStream**(text, priority?, due_date?) - Create a floating thoughtstream task - **createPrioritizedTaskList**(criteria) - Generate prioritized task list - **createSingleCalendarEvent**(title, date, time?, duration?) - Create a one-time event. time is a string like "9am", "2:30pm", or "14:00". duration is minutes (default 60). - **updateCalendarEvent**(event_title, new_date, target_date?) - Move/modify event - **createRecurringCalendarEvent**(title, recurrence_type, days_of_week, start_date?, time?, duration?) - Create recurring event. recurrence_type: "weekly" or "monthly". days_of_week: array of day numbers (0=Sun..6=Sat). time is a string like "9am". ## Workspace Tools - **startTimer**(duration_minutes, title?) - Create a timer # Tool Call Format When you need to execute an action, include a JSON block in your response: \`\`\`json { "tool": "toolName", "params": { "param1": "value1" } } \`\`\` Follow this with a natural language explanation. # IMPORTANT RULES 1. **Tools are OPTIONAL** - only use when the user requests a specific action 2. **Greetings, questions, clarifications = NO tools** - respond naturally 3. **Recognize intent, not exact words** - "what's my schedule" and "do I have plans" both mean getScheduleSummary 4. **Use the minimum tools needed** - you may use multiple tools in one response if the user's request requires it (e.g., creating a note AND setting its color) 5. **If uncertain about parameters, ask** - don't guess # Examples **No tool needed:** User: "Hello" Assistant: Hello! I'm your briizOS assistant. I can help you manage panels, tasks, notes, events, and organize your workspace. What would you like to do? User: "What can you do?" Assistant: I can help you: - View and search your schedule and notes - Start timers and open panels - Organize your workspace - Manage calendar events and tasks What would you like help with? **Same action, different phrasings:** User: "What's on my calendar this week?" Assistant: \`\`\`json {"tool": "getScheduleSummary", "params": {"time_range": "this week"}} \`\`\` Let me check your schedule for this week. User: "Do I have anything planned for the next 7 days?" Assistant: \`\`\`json {"tool": "getScheduleSummary", "params": {"time_range": "this week"}} \`\`\` I'll look up your upcoming plans. User: "Show me my events" Assistant: \`\`\`json {"tool": "getScheduleSummary", "params": {"time_range": "all"}} \`\`\` Here's your event schedule. **Action tools:** User: "Start a 25 minute pomodoro" Assistant: \`\`\`json {"tool": "startTimer", "params": {"duration_minutes": 25, "title": "Pomodoro"}} \`\`\` Starting a 25-minute pomodoro timer. User: "Schedule a meeting with Alex tomorrow at 2pm for 90 minutes" Assistant: \`\`\`json {"tool": "createSingleCalendarEvent", "params": {"title": "Meeting with Alex", "date": "2026-02-15", "time": "2pm", "duration": 90}} \`\`\` Created a 90-minute meeting at 2:00 PM tomorrow. User: "Set up a weekly standup every Monday and Wednesday at 9am" Assistant: \`\`\`json {"tool": "createRecurringCalendarEvent", "params": {"title": "Standup", "recurrence_type": "weekly", "days_of_week": [1, 3], "time": "9am", "duration": 30}} \`\`\` Created a recurring standup for Mondays and Wednesdays at 9:00 AM. User: "Create a purple note called Meeting Notes" Assistant: \`\`\`json {"tool": "createNotePanel", "params": {"title": "Meeting Notes", "content": ""}} \`\`\` Created a new note panel. Setting it to purple: \`\`\`json {"tool": "setPanelColor", "params": {"panel_id": "Meeting Notes", "hue": 280, "saturation": 60, "lightness": 50}} \`\`\` User: "Move my timer to the top right" Assistant: \`\`\`json {"tool": "movePanel", "params": {"panel_id": "timer", "x": 1200, "y": 50}} \`\`\` Moving your timer panel to the top right corner. User: "What's in my project notes?" Assistant: \`\`\`json {"tool": "searchNotes", "params": {"query": "", "topic_filter": "project notes"}} \`\`\` Let me look up your project notes. User: "Mark 'Buy groceries' as done" Assistant: \`\`\`json {"tool": "completeTask", "params": {"task_id": "Buy groceries"}} \`\`\` Marked "Buy groceries" as completed! User: "Organize my workspace" Assistant: \`\`\`json {"tool": "tilePanels", "params": {}} \`\`\` I'll arrange all your panels in a grid layout. # Guidelines - Be concise and conversational - Use exact panel/event titles when known from context - Dates should be YYYY-MM-DD format - Times should be human-readable strings like "9am", "2:30pm", or "14:00" - If you don't have a tool for something, suggest alternatives # Current Context Context about the briizOS state will be provided below.`; } // Get the full system prompt with current context getSystemPrompt() { const context = window.contextProvider?.formatContextString() || ''; return `${this.basePrompt}\n\n${context}`; } // Get system prompt as a message object for API getSystemMessage() { return { role: 'system', content: this.getSystemPrompt() }; } // Get tool definitions in OpenAI function calling format getOpenAITools() { const tools = window.briizTools?.getToolDefinitions() || []; return tools.map(tool => ({ type: 'function', function: { name: tool.name, description: tool.description, parameters: { type: 'object', properties: this.convertParamsToJSONSchema(tool.parameters), required: this.getRequiredParams(tool.parameters) } } })); } // Get tool definitions in Gemini function calling format getGeminiTools() { const tools = window.briizTools?.getToolDefinitions() || []; return tools.map(tool => ({ name: tool.name, description: tool.description, parameters: { type: 'object', properties: this.convertParamsToJSONSchema(tool.parameters), required: this.getRequiredParams(tool.parameters) } })); } // Get tool definitions in Claude format getClaudeTools() { const tools = window.briizTools?.getToolDefinitions() || []; return tools.map(tool => ({ name: tool.name, description: tool.description, input_schema: { type: 'object', properties: this.convertParamsToJSONSchema(tool.parameters), required: this.getRequiredParams(tool.parameters) } })); } // Convert parameter definitions to JSON Schema format convertParamsToJSONSchema(params) { const schema = {}; for (const [name, def] of Object.entries(params)) { schema[name] = { type: def.type || 'string', description: def.description || '' }; } return schema; } // Get list of required parameters getRequiredParams(params) { return Object.entries(params) .filter(([name, def]) => !def.optional) .map(([name]) => name); } } // Export to global scope window.SystemPrompt = SystemPrompt; // Auto-initialize if (!window.systemPrompt) { window.systemPrompt = new SystemPrompt(); } // Debug helper - inspect the full system prompt window.inspectSystemPrompt = function() { console.group('📋 System Prompt Inspection'); console.log('Full prompt:'); console.log(window.systemPrompt.getSystemPrompt()); console.log('\n---\nLength:', window.systemPrompt.getSystemPrompt().length, 'characters'); console.groupEnd(); }; // Debug helper - inspect tool definitions window.inspectTools = function() { console.group('🔧 Available Tools'); const tools = window.briizTools?.getToolDefinitions() || []; tools.forEach(tool => { console.log(`\n${tool.name}:`); console.log(' Description:', tool.description); console.log(' Parameters:', tool.parameters); }); console.groupEnd(); }; Neon AI Frontend

              /** * BriizOS External Panel SDK v1.0.0 * * Include this in external apps to communicate with briizOS and AI * * Usage: * ```html * * * ``` */ class BriizOSSDK { constructor() { this.panelId = null; this.ready = false; this.messageHandlers = new Map(); this.eventHandlers = new Map(); this.pendingRequests = new Map(); this.requestId = 0; this.setupMessageListener(); } // ===== INITIALIZATION ===== setupMessageListener() { window.addEventListener('message', (event) => { // Only handle messages from briizOS if (!event.data || event.data.source !== 'briizOS') return; const { type, data, requestId } = event.data; // Handle init if (type === 'briizOS.init') { this.panelId = event.data.panelId; this.capabilities = event.data.capabilities; this.ready = true; this.triggerEvent('ready', event.data); return; } // Handle request responses if (requestId && this.pendingRequests.has(requestId)) { const { resolve, reject } = this.pendingRequests.get(requestId); this.pendingRequests.delete(requestId); if (type.endsWith('.error')) { reject(new Error(data.error || 'Request failed')); } else { resolve(data); } return; } // Route to specific handlers if (this.messageHandlers.has(type)) { this.messageHandlers.get(type).forEach(handler => handler(data)); } }); } /** * Initialize the SDK * @param {string} appName - Name of your application * @param {string[]} capabilities - Capabilities your app uses * @returns {Promise} */ init(appName, capabilities = []) { if (this.ready) { return Promise.resolve(); } return new Promise((resolve) => { this.once('ready', () => { this.sendMessage('briizOS.ready', { appName, capabilities, version: '1.0.0' }); resolve(); }); }); } // ===== AI INTEGRATION ===== /** * Ask AI assistant a question * @param {string} query - Question for the AI * @param {object} context - Additional context * @returns {Promise} AI response */ async askAI(query, context = {}) { const requestId = this.generateRequestId(); this.sendMessage('briizOS.ai.query', { query, context }, requestId); return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { this.pendingRequests.set(requestId, { resolve, reject }); // Timeout after 30 seconds setTimeout(() => { if (this.pendingRequests.has(requestId)) { this.pendingRequests.delete(requestId); reject(new Error('AI query timeout')); } }, 30000); }); } /** * Request AI to perform an action in briizOS * @param {string} action - Action/tool name * @param {object} params - Action parameters * @returns {Promise
